title: Le Voyage dans la Lune (A Trip to the Moon)
what: Proto science fiction. The capsule is fired from a cannon, lands in the Man in the Moon's eye, and the travellers walk a lunar landscape of spiked growths.
licenceGrounds: published 1902, so copyright has expired in every jurisdiction
the Internet Archive item carries an explicit public domain mark: licenseurl https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/
sourceFile: A Trip to the moon (Le voyage dans la lune) (1902).mp4
audio: none, and this is a LICENCE decision rather than a size one

excerpt.why: The cannon and the launch parade, the Man in the Moon taking the capsule in his eye, the landing, and the lunar landscape. The in and out points are written down so the cut is reproducible from the source rather than being an unrepeatable edit.

audioRemovedBecause: The 1902 film is SILENT. Any audio on the source upload is a modern score, and a modern score carries its own copyright on top of a public domain picture. Keeping it would have quietly reduced a two ground claim to one. This is the opposite of the Dickson film, where the sound WAS the 1894 artefact and was kept.
note: Fetched ONCE and served from our own origin. No visitor request reaches archive.org, which is the standing rule about external sources.
reEncoded: 48.9 MB source to 4.07 MB: audio dropped, 25 fps to 12.5 (a hand cranked 1902 film ran nearer 14, so this is closer to the original than the transfer was), crf 34.
